<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election integrity debate:</strong> Following Congress victories in Maharashtra MLC polls, the BJP has criticized the opposition for questioning EVMs and the ECI, while the Supreme Court has intervened to question the Election Commission on voter notice discrepancies and electoral roll deadlines.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Parliamentary face-off:</strong> Tensions between the BJP and the INDIA bloc have intensified, with citizens&#x27; groups planning a parallel mock parliament in Delhi to counter opposition protests.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Rajya Sabha nomination:</strong> The BJP has officially fielded Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri for the upcoming Rajya Sabha by-poll in Madhya Pradesh.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxNZS16QzlnZzVNaHNJR2I1M1N4N3E5TWszQ1pTUnhGalpkSGs0VjRySlVMdFYzWGI1XzhjWE90dVJ0UU1sdjhaSW9GTjh2RldXWnlMNzNCc080T2szSVVVcHNxZ2x4Z0dBTVlmSDAwSk44LVNBMzF6dmFjRUVhQUMyMDBEZG0tYlQwZzBBYzJGNmR0Rk9SOHNSTmVOaHMtazhadjF4bjZSTkFzT2M?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
</ul>
